No repo existed in the workspace, so I built a minimal faithful reproduction (`/tmp/cobra-dead-flag`, real `github.com/spf13/cobra v1.10.2`, Go 1.26) with the exact reported wiring: `run()` constructs the registry before `ExecuteContext`; dashboard holds a registry.

**RED phase (buggy code) — both bugs reproduced:**

```
--- FAIL: TestE2E_FlagOverridesConfigDataDir   registry.DataDir() = "/cfg/data", want "/flag/data"
--- FAIL: TestE2E_DashboardUsesRegistryDataDir dashboard.DataDir() = "/var/lib/myapp", want registry.DataDir() = "/cfg/data"
```

**GREEN phase (fixed code) — `go vet` clean, all pass:**

| Test | Cases | Verifies |
|---|---|---|
| `TestParseDataDirFlag` | 11 subtests | `--data-dir=/x` and `--data-dir /x` forms; flag before/after subcommand; interleaved with other flags; absent/nil; empty value `--data-dir=` falls back; missing value at end; `--` separator (positional, not flag); `--data-dirx=/x` prefix not matched; repeated flag last-wins (matches pflag) |
| `TestE2E_FlagOverridesConfigDataDir` | 1 | flag wins over config `data_dir` |
| `TestE2E_DashboardUsesRegistryDataDir` | 1 | server uses `registry.DataDir()`, never `DefaultDataDir` |
| `TestE2E_Precedence` | 1 | flag > config > default |
| `TestE2E_CobraParsingAgreesWithPreParse` | 1 | real cobra `ExecuteContext` parses `--data-dir` to the same value as `parseDataDirFlag` — pre-parse doesn't conflict with cobra |

**CLI end-to-end** (config `data_dir = /tmp/e2e-run/cfgdata`, i.e. pointing elsewhere):

```
$ myapp dashboard                          → dashboard data dir: /tmp/e2e-run/cfgdata
$ myapp dashboard --data-dir=/tmp/e2e-run/flagdata  → .../flagdata   (flag wins)
$ myapp dashboard --data-dir /tmp/e2e-run/flagdata2 → .../flagdata2  (space form)
$ myapp --help | grep data-dir → --data-dir string   override configured data dir
```

**Edge cases handled:** flag after subcommand; both spellings; `--` positional barrier; explicit-empty `--data-dir=` falls back to config (matches pflag zero-value semantics); missing value left to cobra's own error during `ExecuteContext`; repeated flags last-wins; the declared flag remains visible in `--help` and functionally parsed post-execution.
